title: Components of Spectrophotometers (Sources, Monochromators, Detectors)

cognitive_progression.level_1_remember: Define fundamental laws, terminology, and bounds of Components of Spectrophotometers (Sources, Monochromators, Detectors).
cognitive_progression.level_2_understand: Explain underlying physical mechanisms, instrumentation, and energy transitions.
cognitive_progression.level_3_apply: Solve quantitative analytical calculations using $$R = \frac{\lambda}{\Delta \lambda} = n \cdot N \quad | \quad D = \frac{dy}{d\lambda} = \frac{F}{d \cos \theta}$$.
cognitive_progression.level_4_analyze: Interpret spectral shifts, evaluate deviations, and troubleshoot analytical anomalies.

pedagogical_boundary.retained_scope: Five essential modules: radiation sources (Tungsten halogen for Vis 350-2500nm, Deuterium D2 for UV 190-380nm, Xenon arc flash), monochromators (prisms vs reflection diffraction gratings, Czerny-Turner mounting), sample cuvettes (quartz/fused silica vs optical glass vs plastic), detectors (phototube, photomultiplier tube PMT, photodiode array PDA/DAD), single-beam vs double-beam in-time and in-space geometries.
pedagogical_boundary.non_forced_clinical_rationale: Focuses on instrumental hardware, optical geometries, and optoelectronic signal transduction. Pure physical instrumentation is preserved without artificial clinical pharmacology tangents.
pedagogical_boundary.excluded_scope: Mass spectrometer detectors and chromatographic hyphenated interfaces.

vision_filtering.policy: Separate core educational diagrams from decorative slide artifacts
